services.title: All the credit you need — from one trusted person.
services.subtitle: Families, professionals, businesses: every need has a structured solution.

items.title: Personal Loans
items.body: Liquidity for your projects, with sustainable instalments and fast approval.
items.detail: For needs up to €75,000, with terms from 24 to 120 months. I compare offers across all partner banks to find the best APR for your profile. Decision in 24-72 hours, typical disbursement within 7 days of signing.

items.title: Home Mortgages
items.body: Primary residence, second home, renovation, refinancing. Real comparison across 40+ banks.
items.detail: From pre-qualification through to the notary deed: I guide you step by step. APR, spread, term and LTV compared across every partner bank. Fixed, variable or hybrid rate based on your risk profile. Up to 100% LTV for first-home under-36 borrowers.

items.title: Salary-Backed Loans
items.body: For employees and pensioners: instalment deducted at source, no guarantors needed.
items.detail: The instalment is withheld directly by the employer or pension fund, up to 20% of net monthly income. No guarantors, no complex checks: a stable employment relationship is enough. Term up to 120 months.

items.title: Business Advisory
items.body: Unsecured loans, leasing, factoring and credit lines for your activity.
items.detail: Analysis of your financial structure and identification of the most effective credit solution: unsecured loans up to 7 years, equipment and real-estate leasing, recourse or non-recourse factoring, invoice advances. Access to public tenders and MCC guarantee fund.

items.title: Risk Analysis
items.body: Preventive credit-bureau check and feasibility study before filing the bank application.
items.detail: Before sending any application, I run a preventive credit check (Crif, CTC, Experian) to avoid filings that would surely be rejected — each recorded rejection worsens your profile. If there are issues, we work on remediation first.

items.title: Real Estate Negotiation
items.body: I support you in price negotiation and notary timing.
items.detail: Property market-value analysis, support in drafting the purchase offer, management of bank approval timing, and coordination with notary and estate agent to reach the deed without surprises.

items.title: Subsidised Mortgages
items.body: Consap guarantee, first-home under-36, young couples fund: I tell you instantly if you qualify.
items.detail: Several public-subsidy tools exist: Consap First-Home Fund (state guarantee up to 50%), Young Couples Fund, Rent Support Fund. In 5 minutes I verify whether you meet income/age requirements and which combination is most advantageous.

items.title: Family Financing
items.body: Cars, education, renovation: we plan together what works best.
items.detail: Often a small targeted loan beats a large mortgage. We analyse the concrete need (car purchase, university studies, home renovation) and pick the cheapest tool: purpose-tied loan, liquidity mortgage or consolidation.

items.title: B2B / Professional Credit
items.body: Invoice advances, shareholder loans, self-employed financing: dedicated solutions.
items.detail: For freelancers and sole proprietorships: dedicated loans based on declared income, invoice advances to manage public-sector payment delays, equipment leasing with tax deduction, shareholder loans at favourable rates.

chiSono.title: A person first, a professional second.
chiSono.shortIntro: For over a decade I've helped Sardinian families and entrepreneurs access credit at the best market conditions.
body: My name is Riccardo Dettori and for over a decade I've helped Sardinian families and entrepreneurs access credit at the best market conditions.

I work as a credit broker partnered with Credipass, one of Italy's most structured networks, with direct access to 40+ banking institutions. I'm registered with the OAM (the Italian Roll of Agents and Brokers) and complete the mandatory Credipass Academy training every year.
What sets me apart isn't how many banks I work with — it's the time I take to listen before proposing. A mortgage lasts 20 or 30 years: it's worth starting well.

faq.title: Real answers to the questions everyone asks me.
faq.subtitle: If you can't find what you're looking for, drop me a line — I reply personally within 24 hours.

items.q: How much does a credit broker cost?
items.a: For **property mortgages** the broker's fee is almost always **fully paid by the chosen bank**, meaning it's free for you. For other loans, any client-side fee must be disclosed in writing before signing — that's OAM law.

items.q: Can I apply for a mortgage before finding a property?
items.a: Yes, with the **Pass Mortgage**. It's a bank pre-qualification that tells you within **48–72 hours** how much the bank is willing to lend you. You enter negotiations with a certain budget, and estate agents take you more seriously.

items.q: What's the difference between a credit broker and a financial advisor?
items.a: A financial advisor invests your wealth (stocks, funds, insurance). A credit broker helps you obtain financing (mortgages, loans, leasing). They are two separate registrations on two distinct rolls. I'm only registered with **OAM**, the credit brokers roll.

items.q: How long does it take to get a mortgage?
items.a: Once your documentation is complete, **pre-approval arrives in 48–72 hours**. The full approval, following the property appraisal, takes **30–45 days**. The notary deed can be signed within **60 days** of application if everything stays on schedule.

items.q: Can I get a mortgage if I'm young or on a fixed-term contract?
items.a: Often, yes. Public guarantee funds (**Consap**, Young Couples Fund) cover up to **50% of the loan for under-36 applicants**. For fixed-term contracts, some banks evaluate professional continuity beyond just permanent positions. Let's check whether you qualify together.

Yes — since Italy's **2007 Bersani Law**, all refinancing costs are borne by the new bank: appraisal, notary, processing, taxes. You change bank and get a better rate without spending a euro. It's worth doing when the APR difference exceeds **0.5–0.7 percentage points**.

items.q: What do I need to start? Which documents should I prepare?
items.a: For the first consultation a call is enough: we talk about your situation and I tell you on the spot if and how it's feasible. Then you'll need: ID, tax code, last 2 payslips (or last 2 tax returns if self-employed), CU, recent bank statements. For mortgages: also the preliminary contract or purchase offer.

items.q: Do you work only in Sardinia, or across Italy?
items.a: I work mainly in Sardinia but can follow cases anywhere in Italy, because the Credipass network is national. The consultation can take place in person, by video call or by phone — your choice.
